title: Free Samples Beat Discounts. Here's Why

scenes.say: Everyone reaches for a discount. A free taste usually sells more.
Say a new pastry is four fifty. Twenty percent off, on a hundred sold, gives away ninety dollars. Ten pastries cut into tastes cost about twelve.

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: I'd never have ordered it. Then I tried a bite.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: I'd never have ordered it. Then I *tried a bite*.

scenes.say: Discounts teach guests to wait for the next deal. A taste sells at full price.

props.fact: Guests learn to wait for the deal. A taste sells at full price.

scenes.say: So: sample the new or pricey item. Small bites, by the register. And hand them out yourself.

props.caption: Sample *smart*
props.title: Free tastes
steps: Pick the new or pricey item
